notes.title: Version 1.0 for Escape the Backrooms Launches October 23!
notes.notes:
Wanderers, it’s almost time…

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42189581/8538bf9c605efdc14ce77b48a03b5aa3a4680c7a.jpg"]

We’re super excited to announce that Version 1.0 of Escape the Backrooms will launch on October 23!

Just in time for the spooky season, prepare for a major expedition, as we finally escape the liminal space known as ‘Early Access’ and no-clip our way into a fully-fledged launch on Steam.

The 1.0 launch comes with a big update on performance and content, including brand new levels, surprises, and improvements. Full patch notes will be shared on October 23, but here are some big things to look out for:

 

Four New Levels – discover more on the origins of the Bacteria in Overgrowth (pictured), expand your M.E.G research in Bunker, get some headspace in Grassrooms, and get up close and personal with Kitty in Level 974

Alternate Endings – search for ways to unlock new endings after completing the main ending. We can’t give too much away, just keep your access cards handy. Also, have a play around in Level 3999 to find a way to track which endings you’ve unlocked

Mission Select – after completing a mission in The Hub mode, you can now select that mission from a list in the lobby

Improved visuals and models – more detail and fidelity for lots of items, the player character, and the Entities

Improvements and expansions to existing levels – find new surprises and details in levels you’ve previously escaped from



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42189581/4f7455a6747b37b1f17605bceb97b1819642f640.jpg"]

 

Before October 23, we’ll share more details on not just the 1.0 update, but also how Escape the Backrooms will be supported post-launch with more updates and content for players. 1.0 is just the beginning, so we hope you find your way out…



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42189581/41f5b9e76a8763dae2fb9c741e2682880e643692.jpg"]



Join the Escape the Backrooms community over on Discord to talk about the 1.0 news, connect with other players, and more!

notes.title: Hotfix #23
notes.notes:
Wanderers, we have an update for Escape the Backrooms rolling out today on Steam!  

To be totally clear straight away: this is not the 1.0 release of the game. Escape the Backrooms is still in Early Access, and this is officially ‘Hotfix #23’, with all credit to Secret Mode for going back into the current version and adding patches for some of the bugs we already fixed for 1.0.

While we make the final tweaks required for the 1.0 launch, we didn’t want to hold back some fixes and improvements to the current game, so we’re rolling out this small update. It addresses more of the community’s recent feedback and reports, including:  

 

•	Garage: Middle Floor - Some hints will last longer on screen 

•	Garage: Level 2 - Fixed players being able to walk through a specific wall 

•	Hotel - Fixed moth jelly occasionally falling through the floor in the Hotel lobby  

•	Poolrooms - Stopped the Hydrolitis plague from insta-killing players, and death will now cause ragdolling 

•	Poolrooms (Expanded) - Fixed Clumps being able to walk into water and get stuck in some areas of the first and third areas 

•	Level Fun (Expanded) – Improved visuals and disabled flashlights in upper level of zone 3  

•	Tunnel – Some hints will last longer on screen, and disabled ability for Bacteria looking up 

 

We hope you enjoy this small update, and will keep you in the loop as we complete the final work for the 1.0 launch of Escape the Backrooms!

notes.title: VR Update

Escape the Backrooms VR mode is out now!

Experience the backrooms in virtual reality with a new VR-compatible mode included with the base game:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42189581/b827bfac5050e94f1288264dc1425a3b6c19dc56.png
